full_name: Sarah Kuhn | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: An associate professor in regional economic and social development at the University of Massachusetts, Lowell, Sarah Kuhn has focused her research on the use of and the design of information technology, for which she uses social science methods to study work processes and the impact of computer technology in the workplace.
